facts.text: The clone is a Python library and MCP server for controlling Rigol MSO5000 series oscilloscopes over VISA
Scope is the high-level API and Scope.connect opens any message-based VISA resource name using the bundled SCPI definitions
info returns the *IDN? reply split into vendor, model, serial and firmware fields
run writes RUN, stop writes STOP and trigger_status reads TRIGger:STATus? (STOP, WAIT, TD, AUTO, RUN)
get_acquisition reads the run state and the ACQuire TYPE, AVERages, SRATe and MDEPth queries
set_acquisition writes ACQuire:TYPE, ACQuire:AVERages and ACQuire:MDEPth, then reads the state back
set_acquisition refuses acquisition writes while the acquisition is stopped, because the instrument would accept and ignore them
The acquisition types are NORMal, AVERages, PEAK and HRESolution
The average count is a power of two from 2 to 65536
The settable memory depths are AUTO, 1k, 10k, 100k, 1M, 10M, 25M, 50M, 100M and 200M
get_channel reads DISPlay, SCALe, OFFSet, UNITs, COUPling, PROBe and BWLimit of one analog channel
set_channel writes the channel settings and returns the read-back state with the requested values it disagrees with
The channel input couplings are DC, AC and GND
The explicit bandwidth filters are OFF, 20M to 600M, and 1G to 20G
The channel probe ratios accepted by the firmware definition run from 0.0001 to 50000
get_timebase reads TIMebase:MODE?, TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe? and TIMebase:MAIN:OFFSet?
set_timebase writes TIMebase:MAIN:SCALe and TIMebase:MAIN:OFFSet and returns the read-back adjustments
Scope.execute validates a command and its arguments and returns the parsed reply of a query
MEASure:ITEM? is the immediate measurement query of one item and source; each query also registers the item on the ten-slot measurement list
The single-source waveform measurement items run from VMAX to NEDGes
The programming guide gives the channel scale range as 500 uV/div to 10 V/div for a 1X probe
The programming guide gives the channel scale range as 10 mV/div to 100 V/div for a 10X probe
The programming guide gives the channel offset range in three vertical-scale bands, from +/-1 V to +/-100 V
The programming guide gives the main timebase scale in YT mode per model, from 1 ns to 1000 s for the MSO5354 and 5 ns to 1000 s for the MSO5072/MSO5074
The programming guide leaves the timebase offset range to remarks that depend on the timebase mode and the operating status
